newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower in lacklustre trade on Tuesday as bearish sentiment carried over from last Friday, when higher-than-expected deliveries at the spot contract expiry depressed prices, traders said.
Newly listed benchmark June futures ended at 147.1 yen a kg after opening at 145.9. The other months were off 0.3 to 1.4.

Bargain-hunting in the distant months later in the day partly offset early losses. "Private investors remained wary of making fresh transactions, as they were more interested in trading more volatile commodity futures such as corn," one commodity broker said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
